decorations: Christmas decorations (they will be separate sprites, so just suggest them lightly): a garland with lights above the window, a tiny Christmas tree in the back-right corner, a wreath on the door.

model.name: Papá Noel de verano
model.description: a jolly, round Santa Claus dressed for a very hot Uruguayan summer: big white beard, rosy sunburned cheeks, a red Santa hat with a white pompom, small round sunglasses, a white sleeveless undershirt, his red Santa jacket tied around the waist by the sleeves, red shorts with white fur trim, black flip-flops (ojotas) and bare legs. Same chibi proportions as the attached wizard (head about one third of the height), slightly taller and wider than him. Colours: reds #7A1E22 #C0392B #E86A4A, whites #FBF4E4 #E9D8B4, skin #F0C090 #E1AE73 #D9826A, outline #150A34.

front view (S) sitting on an invisible stool, hands on the knees
